chain.title: Status chain
chain.chainHint: Draft → In review → Approved — the chain cannot be skipped.

chain.missingBlockTitle: Approve is blocked — missing required fields:

errors.emptyInput: The raw text cannot be empty.
errors.noInputForDraft: Add at least one raw input before generating a draft.
errors.requiredClientAndProject: Client name and project name are required.
errors.notFoundBody: The requested project or page does not exist.
errors.genericBody: The operation did not complete. Try again; if the error persists, check the server log.
errors.invalidTransition: Invalid phase transition — the state may have changed. Refresh the page.
errors.noteRequired: A reason is required to close the gate.
errors.artifactNotDraft: The artifact is not a draft — this operation only works on drafts.

errors.versionConflict: Version conflict — another version was created in the meantime. Refresh the page.
errors.fieldValueRequired: The field value cannot be empty.
errors.fieldNotConfirmable: Only an AI proposal with a value can be confirmed.

errors.approveOnlyFromReview: Approve is only possible from In review — the chain cannot be skipped.
